expectation: Membrane ring on B cells (incl. early plasmablasts), dim to moderate, as clusters in lymphoid follicles or aggregates, with scattered single cells in lamina propria. Cells should sit on HLADRA-positive cells.
observed: A: sparse saturated yellow dots scattered across tissue and also in empty background between sections, with no follicle-like clusters. B: faint diffuse stripes, no cells. C: a few round blobs, one huge, near the epithelium. D: blurry blobs, not rings. E1: no CD19 signal in an HLADRA-dense field.
why: Isolated saturated specks, some off tissue, with no clustering and no CD19 in the HLADRA-dense field, indicate debris rather than a B-cell population.
